diag.bus.none.auto: no bus configured (bus.bind is auto, but the {server} entry has no bus) -> auto copies it from there, just fill it in
diag.bus.invalid: bus.bind is {value}, which is not a valid address (expected e.g. 127.0.0.1:25600) -> the bus will not start; leave it empty or set auto to copy the bus of the entry you own
diag.server.reason.local: managed here, players from MCDR events
diag.check.owner.fail: this instance does not own it
diag.check.idle.waiting: idle {idle} min / threshold {limit} min, not yet
diag.check.busy: the server is busy (backup/save), recheck in {seconds}s

command.help.hover.check:
surface config problems found
statically (bus up? duplicated
addresses? nobody manages one?)
command.screen.check_hint: after editing the config run !!ig reload, then check again
check.hint: item 1 matters most - with no bus running, every cross-instance action is dead
check.bus.duplicated: {first} and {second} share the bus address {address} - they will fight over the port, give each its own
check.server.duplicated_name: {count} entries in servers[] are all named {server} - the later one silently replaces the earlier, while the table shows two rows with the same name; give them distinct names
check.bus.token: this instance token fingerprint {fingerprint} - every instance must match (compare bus.token in each config.json; a mismatch shows up as an auth failure)
check.bus.auto_no_bus: the bus will not start: bus.bind is auto (or unset) and the {server} entry has no bus either - auto copies it from there, just fill it in
check.bus.invalid: bus.bind is {value}, not a valid address (expected e.g. 127.0.0.1:25600) - the bus will not start; leave it empty or set auto and it copies the bus of the entry you own
diag.bus.none.watch: bus not started (this instance manages no server) -> normal for a watch-only instance; if a server should be managed here, check that its server-port matches the port in servers[]
check.bus.default_token: bus.token is still the legacy default idle_guard - across machines it is the only defence, change it (freshly generated configs get a random token automatically)
check.unowned.watch: {server} has auto sleep on but its role is watch - no instance will ever stop it
check.unowned.no_bus: {server} uses role auto (expecting the MCDR whose port matches) but has no bus - that instance cannot find it
check.peer.none: peers not probed yet: wait a few seconds (heartbeat) or run !!ig diag
